**Truthammer — 10 October 2026**

Yuckie, Hammerton Harry Drizddon, Dain Truthammer and Stu take the ground route, with Dain riding Stu in brown-bear form. The others go by blimp.

From Stu’s back, Dain casts Suggestion on the smarter of the two goblin captives: “you must do as I say and be silent.” Success.

Harry intimidates the other captive: “ That brother, brothers fam, you better listen to them very carefully.” Her intimidation outcome and the goblin’s response haven’t been reported.

The reason why the snake people organise the goblins remains unanswered.
